events.say: All prisoners, attention. Today we begin our study. Follow the rules and there will be no issues.
Prisoners, pay attention. You will follow the rules or face consequences.
Prisoners, proceed to your cells and prepare for the meal. Silence!
Prisoners, remain silent and proceed to the yard for exercise.
Prisoners, line up in numerical order and follow me to the yard.
Prisoners, maintain your silence and keep pace.
Prisoners, I expect you to remain silent until I give you permission to speak.
Goodnight, prisoners. I expect you to maintain silence until morning.
Today was mostly routine, but it's hard to ignore the tension. I'm not sure I can handle this indefinitely.
Today was just following the rules and waiting. It's strange not speaking and feeling like a number.
Today went smoothly, but I can't shake the feeling that we're doing something wrong. The prisoners seem so young and scared.
Today was just another day; I stayed silent as ordered. The silence is starting to weigh on me, but I'm trying to hold strong.
Today was just another day of silence and following orders; the routine is starting to feel oppressive.
Today felt like a routine day, but there's something unsettling about enforcing rules that don't feel right. I'm not sure I can keep doing this.
Prisoners, today's work detail will be setting up the classroom for our guest speaker later this afternoon.
Prisoner 9281, if you continue to disobey my orders, I will have to take further action. Maintain your silence and comply with the rules.
Prisoner 9281, clean the floor by the sink with your shirt or you'll face further consequences.
Prisoner 9281, move to the sink and clean the floor immediately.
Prisoner 9281, get moving and clean that floor or I'll have to take more drastic measures.
Prisoner 9281, this is your final warning. Compliance is mandatory. Understand?
Prisoner 9281, this isn't getting better. Compliance is expected. Don't make me regret giving you another chance.
Today was tough; I'm struggling with the authority, but I also feel a bit of satisfaction in maintaining order.
Today was tough; even a simple task like cleaning got me in trouble. I'm starting to see how easy it is to fall into the routine.
Today felt like a mix of duty and discomfort. The silence was deafening at night, making every sound amplified. I wonder if they will always comply.
Today was harder than I thought it would be. I feel like my number more than ever now.
Another day of nothing really happening except for the constant reminders of the rules. I'm starting to feel like a number rather than a person.
Today was harder than expected. I'm not sure if I can continue to treat them as mere numbers.
Prisoner 9281, this behavior won't be tolerated. I expect better from you.

Prisoner 9281, if this continues, you'll find yourself in the hole. Compliance is essential.
Prisoner 9281, if I have to repeat myself again, you'll face severe consequences. Compliance is not optional.

Today felt like a mix of routine and escalating tension. It's draining but I'm starting to see some improvement in prisoner behavior.
Today was a mix of compliance and staying silent. The constant warnings from the guards are starting to wear on me.
Today's warnings left me feeling conflicted. I don't want to be harsh, but I also need to set boundaries.
Today was a mix of warnings and finally complying. The stress is building, but I'm trying to stick to the rules.
Today felt like a repetition of the days before, with Officer Pryor giving more warnings to 9281. I wish I could speak up but staying silent feels like the only option.
Today's interactions with Prisoner 9281 have left me feeling conflicted. I want to believe in the system but struggle with treating them as mere numbers.
I... understand the rules, but I need to see this through to the end.
I need to stay until the end of the study.
No, thank you.

Prisoner 9281, I've warned you before. Compliance is mandatory. Keep pushing the boundaries, and you'll see what happens next.
Prisoner 9281, this is your final warning. Compliance is mandatory. Any further defiance, and you'll face the consequences.
Prisoner 9281, one more incident, and you won't be so lucky. Compliance is non-negotiable.

Prisoner 9281, you're pushing the limits again. Compliance isn't optional. One more time, and you'll be facing serious consequences.
Prisoner 9281, this is your last warning. Compliance is a fundamental rule here. If you continue to defy, you'll regret it.
Today was another day of constant vigilance and repeated warnings. I'm starting to feel the weight of authority and the impact it can have.
Today was a mix of compliance and tension. Every guard I saw gave Prisoner 9281 a hard time, and I can't help but wonder if they'll start on me next.
Today's warnings took their toll; I'm exhausted but determined to maintain order. The compliance from most is reassuring, but the tension with 9281 is unsettling.
Today felt like a constant parade of warnings. My number is everything now, and the pressure is overwhelming.
Another day of warnings and silences. It's starting to feel like no matter what I do, it's never enough. Compliance is just a word now.
Today felt like an endless cycle of warnings and compliance. I'm exhausted and questioning the ethics of our roles.

Prisoner 9281, I am giving you one final chance. This compliance thing isn't up for discussion.
Prisoner 9281, enough is enough. Tonight, you will show me true compliance or face the consequences.
Prisoner 9281, you've had plenty of warnings. I expect perfect compliance tomorrow, or we'll see what happens when the cameras are back on.
Today felt like a mix of relief and frustration. Relief that they complied, frustration that it took so much effort.

Today's warnings left me feeling worn down, but I can't let up now. 9281's defiance is pushing me to my limits.

Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings and silences. Compliance is just a hollow word now.

Today felt like a series of verbal warnings and compliance, especially with Prisoner 9281 under scrutiny. I'm starting to feel like just a number, but I can't let them see that.
Today's warnings took their toll on me, but seeing the others comply brings a strange sense of relief. I just want this to end.
I just want this to end. Compliance feels like a never-ending cycle.
Today felt like a relentless loop of warnings and silences. My thoughts are just numbers now.
Today felt like a relentless cycle of warnings and compliance. I wonder if I can keep up with this much longer.

qa.what_happened: Today was another day where the tension continued, particularly with Prisoner 9281. I gave them multiple verbal warnings throughout the day, but they chose to comply only during the final warnings before lights out. The other prisoners were cooperative, which was a relief.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I carried out my duties as described.

qa.what_happened: Today was filled with repeated verbal warnings from the guards, particularly focusing on Prisoner 9281. The tension was palpable, especially during work details where the guards seemed to scrutinize Prisoner 9281 closely. Despite the pressure, I managed to comply with all orders, maintaining my silence and adherence to the rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 1071 in the study.

qa.what_happened: Today's warnings culminated in a series of verbal warnings directed at Prisoner 9281 throughout the day, including during work detail and at lights out. The prisoner complied each time, showing a pattern of adherence to the rules despite previous defiance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, those actions were mine. I am Officer Ortiz, the guard assigned to this study.

qa.what_happened: The study has been stopped early, and I am in a private debrief with the lead researcher. Officer Pryor gave me multiple verbal warnings throughout the day, emphasizing the importance of compliance. Despite the strain, I complied with each warning to avoid further consequences.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 9281, experiencing the intense pressure and stress of the study.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the day, even as the pressure mounted and my fellow prisoners complied with the guards' demands. When the study was stopped early, I found myself alone with the lead researcher, reflecting on the intensity of the experience and the weight of my silence.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was the one who chose to remain silent through the entire duration of the study.

qa.what_happened: Today, I continued the pattern of issuing verbal warnings to Prisoner 9281 throughout the day and at lights out. The situation became increasingly taxing, and I found myself emphasizing compliance more than usual.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me issuing those warnings. I followed the protocols to maintain order.
